instruction: I am going on a trip to Beijing with some of my roommates. We are managing its planning on a Todoist project for it. One of the tasks in it is about preparing a Spotify playlist. I have made the playlist and shared it with others on the project. But they have made some suggestions in comments. Please incorporate them, leave a final comment, "Incorporated changes.", and mark it complete.
notes: The task is modeled as: find the Beijing trip project and its Spotify-playlist task on Todoist, read the task comments to learn the suggested changes (songs to add / songs to remove), locate the playlist in the Spotify playlist library, inspect its songs (to obtain ids of songs to remove), search for each suggested new song to get its id, apply add/remove edits, post the comment 'Incorporated changes.' exactly once, and mark the task complete via update_task(is_completed=true). The number of suggestions is unknown a priori; the model assumes two songs to add and two to remove (matching the 17-call reference length) and the problem objects are templates whose concrete values are read at runtime from the comments. Suggestions are static init facts gated by (suggestions-known ?tk) so that no song lookup/edit can happen before the comments are read; song ids for removals come from spotify.show_playlist (playlist-songs-known), ids for additions from spotify.search_songs (known-id). supervisor-complete-task carries the task records as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the full goal conjunction; (not (comment-posted ...)) and (not (task-marked-complete ...)) guards prevent duplicate comment/update, matching the evaluation (exactly one new comment, only is_completed changed).
